what: Replace every test stand-in for prismis's own code with the real collaborator, and add a guard test that fails when a test patches prismis_daemon or cli internals outside an LLM-entry-point allowlist.
why: Constitution Principle I: internal code is never mocked; LLM providers are the only permitted fake (.specify/memory/constitution.md, Principle I and Project Constraints). A test against a fake proves the fake, not prismis. The mypy migration (8a99235) left every remaining violation marked in place with `# type: ignore[...]  # internal fake, removed by docs/work/no-internal-mocks`, and the `# claudex-guard: allow-mock` marker is attached to internal patches (get_circuit_breaker, Config.from_file, get_db_connection, Storage methods), so the honor system is not holding. Closes #73 and #62.

criteria.given: the daemon and cli test trees after this unit
criteria.when: the guard test scans every test file under daemon/tests and cli/tests
criteria.then: it passes: no patch, patch.object, monkeypatch.setattr or attribute assignment replaces anything under prismis_daemon or cli except the allowlist (llm_core.complete as imported into a prismis_daemon module, llm_core.health_check, and module-level configuration constants). It can only pass after the other criteria's replacements land, since the scan of the real tree only passes once their violations are gone

observation.command: cd daemon && uv run pytest -q --no-header tests/unit/test_no_internal_mocks_unit.py 2>&1 | tail -1

criteria.given: a test file containing a patch of an internal prismis_daemon or cli target
criteria.then: the guard reports that file and target; a self-test plants such a violation in a temp file and asserts detection, and another plants an allowlisted llm_core.complete patch and asserts it passes

observation.command: cd daemon && uv run pytest -q --no-header tests/unit/test_no_internal_mocks_unit.py -k detects 2>&1 | tail -1

criteria.given: the daemon tests outside the three deep-extraction files (those are SC-4) and outside test_api_connection_cleanup (a call-through spy, out of scope)
criteria.when: searched for patches, attribute assignments and injected stand-ins of prismis_daemon internals, and for the markers the mypy migration left on them
criteria.then: none remain: test_orchestrator_deep_unit, test_notifier_unit, test_storage_dict_unit, test_llm_core_migration_unit, test_verify_subcommand_unit and test_context_assistant drive the real Storage over the sealed test DB, the real CircuitBreaker, the real Config from the sealed XDG config, the real Notifier and the real Summarizer/Evaluator against the local stub LLM server; llm_core.complete and llm_core.health_check patches stay

observation.command: echo "count=$(grep -rnE 'internal fake, removed by|"prismis_daemon\.[A-Za-z_.]+"|patch\.object\([A-Za-z_]+, "|\._send_notification = ' daemon/tests | grep -vE 'test_api_connection_cleanup|test_deep_extractor_unit|test_deep_extractor_api_integration|test_extract_endpoint_race' | grep -vE '\.complete"|health_check"|import_module|logger=' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

criteria.when: searched for stand-ins of ContentDeepExtractor or CircuitBreaker
criteria.then: none remain: those tests drive the real ContentDeepExtractor against the local stub LLM server and open the real CircuitBreaker with real quota failures; _FakeTokens/_FakeResult (provider result fakes) are allowed

criteria.when: searched for patches of the CLI's own API client or of httpx standing in for the daemon
criteria.then: none remain: the cli tests call a real in-process daemon against a seeded temp DB through the real APIClient

outOfScope: Patches of the LLM provider (llm_core.complete, llm_core.health_check) and the _FakeTokens/_FakeResult provider fakes: permitted by the constitution
PRAW submission Mocks in test_reddit_fetcher_unit and fixtures/reddit_mocks: Reddit is a third party
praw class-attribute configuration in test_ambient_config_integration and test_reddit_fetcher_budget_integration: configures the library, fakes nothing
test_api_connection_cleanup: its Storage wrappers call through to the real methods (a spy, not a fake)
Restoring the credential-gated live-LLM tests (gh #60) and the openai SDK migration (docs/work/wo-openai-sdk-migration.md)
stakes: Every replacement test must be shown to FAIL with the behavior it covers disabled, then restored (CLAUDE.md Learned Patterns). A replacement that passes with the logic removed is the tautology it replaced.

The gate runs in public CI with no credentials and no network. LLM calls go through local_pipeline_stub / configure_local_services in daemon/tests/conftest.py or a patched llm_core.complete; the deep-extraction and race tests need a stub response shaped for the deep schema, and the race test's slow extraction comes from a delay in that stub server, not a stub extractor.
Assert at the level each original test's criterion names (CLAUDE.md): turning a composition test into isolated pure-function tests leaves the composition unproven.
Never weaken, delete or reorder an assertion to make a real collaborator pass. If a real collaborator exposes a real bug, stop and report it.
mypy is part of the gate now: new code and tests must type-check under `uv run mypy .` in each unit with no new `# type: ignore`.
The lane runs ./.specify/verify.sh (ruff, mypy, pytest, go checks) after every job; the gate passing is required of every job and is not a criterion or a job of its own.
